paragraphs.en: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown's 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas. Some rest in the shade of a parked car. Others drink water with the cows. This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate- friendly eggs.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近一个阳光明媚的日子里，13000只鸡在德克萨斯州Shiner的LarryBrown那片40英亩的多风土地上漫步。一些鸡在停放的汽车阴影下休息。另一些则和奶牛一起喝水。这一切看似随意，但实际上是经过设计的，是这个价值61亿美元的美国鸡蛋产业押注的下一个大趋势的一部分:气候友好型鸡蛋。

sentences.en: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown's 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas.
Some rest in the shade of a parked car.
Others drink water with the cows.
This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate- friendly eggs.

paragraphs.en: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases. Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change.
paragraphs.zh: 这些鸡蛋目前正在货架上首次亮相，售价高达每打8美元，它们仍然标有有机和动物友好的标签，但它们也来自生活在使用再生农业的农场上的鸟类——这种特殊技术培育能够捕获温室气体的肥沃土壤。这类鸡蛋可以作为帮助对抗气候变化的产品进行营销。

sentences.en: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases.
Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change.

paragraphs.en: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat. The birds' waste then fertilizes fields. Such improvements "allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers."
paragraphs.zh: "我对我们的进展感到兴奋，"为位于丹佛的NestFreshEggs收获鸡蛋的Brown说，他正在增加更多覆盖作物，以吸引蚯蚓和蟋蟀供鸡食用。然后鸟类的粪便为田地施肥。这些改进"使我们的母鸡能够觅食更高质量的天然饲料，这对土地、母鸡以及我们供应给客户的鸡蛋都有好处。"

sentences.en: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.
The birds' waste then fertilizes fields.
Such improvements "allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers."

paragraphs.en: The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering. In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart. More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories. If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond.
paragraphs.zh: 鸡蛋行业的推动是对来自再生农场的动物产品能否成为下一个高端产品的首次重大考验。在短短十多年里，有机鸡蛋从被视为天然食品商店的小众产品发展到在沃尔玛销售。最近，益生菌和植物基肉类也曾遭遇类似质疑，但两者都已爆发式增长成为超市的主要品类。如果可持续鸡蛋的推出取得成功，它可能为再生牛肉、西兰花及更多产品打开闸门。

sentences.en: The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering.
In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart.
More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories.
If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond.

paragraphs.en: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine. Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein).
paragraphs.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学Brandywine分校农业经济学副教授JulieStanton说，再生产品可能难以销售，因为这个概念很难快速定义。这种农业方式对食品本身的改善也极少，甚至没有(尽管一些生产商声称他们的鸡蛋含有更多蛋白质)。

sentences.en: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine.
Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein).

paragraphs.en: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability. Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment. Young adults "really care about the planet," says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations. "They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."
paragraphs.zh: 该行业押注那些愿意为自由放养、非转基因和牧场饲养等优质属性支付更多费用的消费者将会接受可持续性。调查显示，年轻一代更关注气候变化，植物基肉类的部分成功可以归因于购物者希望表明他们保护环境的愿望。EggInnovations总裁JohnBrunnquell说，年轻人"真的很关心地球","他们正在彻底改变食物链，其影响甚至超出了我认为他们自己所理解的程度。"

sentences.en: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability.

Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment.
Young adults "really care about the planet," says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations.
"They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."

insights.en: Some rest in the shade of a parked car.
insights.note: 本句是"主语+不及物动词+地点状语"的基本句型，在真题和日常阅读中较为常见，具有一定代表性。同时，过去分词作前置定语（"aparkedcar"）也是高频考点。不过由于句子过于简短且无从句，缺乏更复杂的典型句式特征（如定语从句、状语从句等），典型性相对一般。

insights.en: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.
insights.note: 直接引语+倒装主句+非限制性定语从句+限制性定语从句嵌套，是四六级和考研阅读中极为常见的复杂句式；关系代词who/that的用法、非限从的逗号分隔、从句嵌套层级都是高频考点，掌握后可大量复用。

insights.en: Such improvements "allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers."
insights.note: 使役动词allow+宾语+不定式补足语,以及双层限制性定语从句嵌套,均为四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式。该句型既体现了复杂修饰关系,又保持了主干清晰,是真题长难句的典型代表。掌握此结构后可迁移到大量同类句子的分析,实用性强。

insights.en: The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering.
insights.note: 主句采用主系表结构，表语后接介词加从句的形式，这是四六级和考研阅读中常见的句式；宾语从句由"whether"引导表示疑问内容，也是典型的名词性从句用法；整体结构具有较高的代表性和迁移价值。

insights.en: Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein).
insights.note: 主句+让步状语从句（though）+从句内嵌套宾语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的常见结构。插入语、后置定语、省略that的宾语从句都是高频句式特征，学习后可广泛迁移到同类真题句。

insights.en: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability.
insights.note: "主句+that引导的宾语从句"以及"现在分词短语作后置定语"都是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式，掌握后可以复用到大量类似句子的理解中，具有较强的代表性。
